source.quote: Although we operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model, we also rely on our own manufacturing facilities, in particular in Fort Collins, Colorado, Singapore, and Breinigsville, Pennsylvania.

notes: The FY2024 10-K gives employees only as regional percentages (North America 48%, Asia 36%, EMEA 16% of ~37,000); headcounts were not derived. Item 2 splits facilities over 100,000 sq ft only into United States (3,769,028 sq ft) and Other Countries (3,283,661 sq ft), so no country rows. The 10-K also says a significant majority of R&D personnel are in the Czech Republic, India, Israel and the U.S., without numbers. Broadcom publishes EU public country-by-country tax reports (with employees by jurisdiction) on investors.broadcom.com, but that host returned 403 Access Denied to every fetch this session, so they are not used; worth a retry with a browser. No state-level data found. Sites are from the 10-K's own descriptions; the Singapore row cites the manufacturing sentence because its description is the company's generic wording.
